articles.title: Brad Pitt and Angelina Jolie settle years-long legal battle over joint French winery
articles.summary: Pitt filed the lawsuit against Jolie in 2022 after she sold her stake in Château Miraval, saying she broke their agreement not to sell their interests

articles.title: The Fox review – talking animals are the least weird thing in this delightfully peculiar comedy
articles.summary: Dario Russo’s debut feature is Brothers Grimm meets Yorgos Lanthimos, with a standout cast including Olivia Colman, Sam Neill and Emily Browning

articles.title: 14th review – Ava DuVernay takes on a bully president and his viper’s-nest court of Maga sycophants
articles.summary: DuVernay’s follow-up to her dissection of the 13th Amendment to the US constitution is a vehement and exhilarating defence of democracy

articles.title: ‘I said no thanks to the casting couch. But other actresses had problems’: Jane Alexander on 50 years of stardom
articles.summary: The Great White Hope, All the President’s Men, Kramer vs Kramer … Alexander has a CV most actors can only dream of. She talks us through the highs and lows – including a ‘beautiful’ encounter with Muhammad Ali

articles.title: Reeling in the years: how Hollywood fell for its own vanishing glories
articles.summary: The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth is the latest in a growing wave of movies steeped in nostalgia for a heyday in stark contrast to its current ruination

articles.title: ‘I needed to purge it out of me’: the shocking true story behind harrowing drama Josephine
articles.summary: Writer-director Beth de Araújo witnessed a brutal sexual assault as a child and has turned her experience into one of the year’s most powerful movies

articles.title: The Slightest Touch review – running marathons in Colin Farrell and Emma Fogarty’s odd-couple friendship
articles.summary: The pair, who met in 2010, are shown preparing for the Dublin race to raise awareness of Fogarty’s epidermolysis bullosa in Rachel Fleit’s considerate documentary

articles.title: Way of the Warrior Kid review - Chris Pratt’s family film is as subtle as a military recruitment video
articles.summary: Apple’s tone-deaf Karate Kid knock-off feels like a Maga-approved after-school special
